description: This file implements a Spark Streaming application that counts words received over a network socket, with recoverable checkpointing and filtering of specific words. It includes functions for creating the streaming context, managing broadcast variables and accumulators, and processing streaming data.

methods.name: getWordExcludeList
methods.description: Returns a broadcast list of words to exclude, creating and broadcasting it if not already available.

methods.name: getDroppedWordsCounter
methods.description: Returns an accumulator counting dropped words, creating it if not already available.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates and configures a Spark StreamingContext that connects to a network socket, processes incoming text data, filters out specified words, and writes counts to an output file.
